name: Island of Treasures 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: In Island of Treasures, you are stranded on a treasure-filled island where you must race for your life, battling nefarious pirates and collecting riches along the way. Island of Treasures is a casual, arcade, endless runner game where every second counts, and your goal is to be faster and better than you were in the previous gameplay.
